candidates.title: Hemingway Color
candidates.description: Hemingway crater is seen in this color view of Mercury surface as seen by NASA MESSENGER spacecraft. Hemingway is the 130-km 81-mile diameter crater with a relatively brown floor and small patch of dark blue in its center.
